title: Change Customer clears an Authorizer from a payer that stays
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with two contacts, contact B1 and contact B2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, where customer B was picked on the Customer card, with contact B1 saved as Authorizer.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  4. Pick customer D.
  5. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • Authorizer shows contact B1.
  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The customer picker opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 5:

  • The work order's customer is customer D.
  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
  • Authorizer is cleared and reads "No authorizer".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
